elements.text: The selected paper defines the architecture. Adjacent work supplies context.

Research	Contribution	Project implication
RagaMoodSync (2025)	FusDenseNet and FDCF	Implement mechanisms, disclose assumptions
FER challenge (2013)	Facial-expression benchmark	Keep held-out classification evaluation
DenseNet (2017)	Dense feature reuse	Use concatenated earlier features
Neural CF (2017)	Learned neural matching	Learn user/music interaction representations
